description: Get accounts a user follows. Paginated.

count.description: How many users to request per page (default 20). X may return slightly more or fewer.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Leave empty for the first page; pass the next_cursor from a previous result to get the next page.

format.description: Response format (default simple). simple: compact JSON with flat camelCase tweets and users, about 60% fewer tokens. raw: X's full GraphQL JSON, only needed for fields simple leaves out (cards, polls, edit history, community notes).

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of JSON to return (default 50000). Longer output is cut with a [TRUNCATED] marker. Lower it to save context, raise it if you need the full response.

userId.description: Numeric X user ID (rest_id). Provide this or username. Using the ID is faster.

username.description: X handle, used when you do not have the user ID. Provide this or userId.

name: get_following
title: Get following
